dossier.summary: Quillstone reviews vendor contracts for in-house legal teams and flags clauses that differ from the team's own playbook. Legal teams upload a contract and get a marked-up copy back.

shortlist.title: General Counsel
shortlist.why: A one-person legal team that reviews every vendor contract herself.

shortlist.title: Senior Legal Counsel
shortlist.why: Handles commercial contracts, so redlines against a playbook are his week.

shortlist.name: Clara Jensen
shortlist.title: Head of Legal Operations
shortlist.why: Owns how legal works, and picks the tools the team uses.

emails.name: Hannah Brandt
emails.title: General Counsel
emails.subject: Vendor contracts at Oakmere
body: As the only lawyer at Oakmere, every vendor contract waits on you.
Quillstone reads each one against your own playbook and sends back a marked-up copy, so you start from the clauses that differ instead of page one.
Would a sample markup on one of your templates help?

emails.name: Clara Jensen
emails.subject: Contract review at Tessera
body: Legal ops at Tessera probably decides how contract review gets done, not just who does it.
Quillstone checks vendor contracts against your playbook and flags what differs, so the team reviews the exceptions.
emails.ps: PS: It works from your own playbook, so nothing changes about how the team marks up a contract.
